description: Block definitions for generate-blocks.sh. Each block produces a standalone HTML file.

defaults.suffix: Output raw HTML only, starting with <!DOCTYPE html>.

blocks.name: Parallel Coords + Sparkline Table
blocks.prompt: Parallel coordinates (6 axes) with sparkline summary table. 150 synthetic cities with correlated metrics (population, temp, elevation, rainfall, GDP, density) across 6 regions. Intersection brushing filters both views. Table shows distribution sparklines, min/median/max for brushed subset with live count badge.

blocks.name: Linked Scatterplot Matrix
blocks.prompt: 4x4 scatterplot matrix (SPLOM) with linked brushing. 200 synthetic iris-like points (4 numeric columns, 3 species). KDE density on diagonals. Brushing any cell highlights the same points across all cells via d3.dispatch.

blocks.name: Violin Plot Orchestra
blocks.prompt: Split violin grid: 12 months × 6 cities (Oslo to Singapore). Left half = 2010s, right half = 2020s (slightly warmer). KDE-derived area paths. Shared y-scale reveals both seasonal patterns and decadal warming shift.

blocks.name: Bee Swarm Census
blocks.prompt: Bee swarm of 400 synthetic people by income (log-normal, 15K–500K) colored by education level (4 categories, correlated with income). Annotated percentile lines, leader-line callouts for top earners, and a marginal box plot summarizing the overall distribution.

blocks.name: Crossfilter Flight Explorer
blocks.prompt: Crossfilter with 3 linked histograms (departure hour, delay, distance). 2000 synthetic flights with bimodal departure peaks. Brushing one filters the other two. Intersection logic, live counter, reset button.

blocks.name: QQ Plot with Confidence Bands
blocks.prompt: Normal QQ plot of 200 values from a skewed mixture (80% normal + 20% shifted). 95% confidence envelope highlights tail deviations. Inset histogram with fitted normal overlay. Hover shows value and z-score.

blocks.name: Density Contour Heatmap
blocks.prompt: 2D density visualization: 8,000 points from 3 bivariate normal clusters (unequal sizes). Raw points under contour density fills. Brush-to-zoom recomputes contours at the zoomed scale for local detail. Double-click resets.

blocks.name: Small Multiples Seasonal
blocks.prompt: 12-panel small multiples (4×3) of daily energy consumption by month. 3 overlaid years show seasonal pattern (winter heating, summer AC). Synchronized vertical crosshair across all panels with tooltip.

blocks.name: Sparkline Dashboard Table
blocks.prompt: Sortable stock table with 25 rows. Embedded sparklines per row: 30-day price area, 7-day volume bars, 20-day win/loss strip, performance bullet chart vs target. Click headers to sort with animated row repositioning.

blocks.name: Strip Plot with Marginals
blocks.prompt: Scatterplot (age vs cholesterol, 250 points, 3 risk groups) with marginal strip plots and box plots in top and right margins. Regression line with R² annotation. Brushing updates marginal summaries.

blocks.name: Zoomable Treemap
blocks.prompt: Zoomable treemap of a 3-level synthetic file system (~400 files, log-distributed sizes, 8 top-level dirs). Click any directory to zoom in with animated transitions. Breadcrumb bar for navigation back. Leaf labels appear when cells are large enough.

blocks.name: Sunburst to Icicle Morph
blocks.prompt: Hierarchy morph between sunburst and icicle layouts. 3-level org chart (~150 leaves). Toggle interpolates between arc and rect coordinates over 1200ms. Hover highlights ancestors and shows path.

blocks.name: Radial Dendrogram + Edge Bundling
blocks.prompt: Radial dendrogram with hierarchical edge bundling. ~120 leaf nodes (software modules), ~80 cross-module dependency edges. LCA path routing with d3.curveBundle. Tension slider 0–1. Hover highlights a node's dependency edges.

blocks.name: Force-Directed Clustering
blocks.prompt: Force-directed network: 400 nodes in 7 clusters (~600 edges, 80% intra-cluster). Nodes sized by value, colored by cluster. Drag reheats simulation. Hover highlights a node's neighborhood with degree tooltip. Quadtree hit detection.

blocks.name: Adjacency Matrix Reorder
blocks.prompt: 35×35 adjacency matrix (5 communities, ~200 weighted edges). Three reorder buttons: name, degree, community. Rows/columns animate to new positions. Side bar chart shows node degree. Hover highlights row and column.

blocks.name: Sankey Energy Flow
blocks.prompt: Sankey diagram: energy flow from 6 sources through generation, grid, sectors to 6 end uses (~35 links across 5 stages). Loss flows highlighted distinctly. Drag nodes vertically. Hover highlights connected paths with flow values and percentages.

blocks.name: Chord Diagram of Trade
blocks.prompt: Chord diagram of trade flows between 10 countries (asymmetric matrix). Entrance animation: arcs grow then chords appear. Hover a country arc to isolate its trade flows. Tick marks show volume in billions.

blocks.name: Collapsible Tree with Search
blocks.prompt: Collapsible horizontal tree of biological taxonomy (~200 nodes, 5 levels). Search box auto-expands paths to matches and highlights them. Click nodes to expand/collapse with transitions. Collapsed nodes show descendant count.

blocks.name: Circle Packing Zoom
blocks.prompt: Zoomable circle packing of ~300 Wikipedia articles in 6 categories. Click any circle to zoom in with d3.interpolateZoom. Labels appear/disappear by LOD. Breadcrumb shows current path.

blocks.name: Arc Diagram
blocks.prompt: Arc diagram of 30 character co-occurrences in a synthetic novel. Nodes on x-axis by first appearance, arcs above proportional to co-occurrence weight. Hover highlights a character's connections. Brush selects chapter range.

blocks.name: US Choropleth
blocks.prompt: US state choropleth of synthetic broadband-access percentages (50 states + DC). Self-contained inline geometry, no external fetches. Sequential color scale with threshold legend. Hover tooltips, click-to-zoom to a state. AlbersUsa projection.

blocks.name: Rotating Globe
blocks.prompt: Interactive rotating globe with 30 pulsing city points. Canvas multi-layer (ocean, land, graticule, cities). Auto-rotates, drag to rotate (versor). Color cities by continent. Day/night terminator line.

blocks.name: Hex Bin Map
blocks.prompt: Hex-binned US map of 20,000 synthetic GPS points concentrated around population centers. Canvas hexagons colored by count. Slider adjusts hex radius (4–16px) and recomputes. State outlines overlay.

blocks.name: Flow Map with Curved Arrows
blocks.prompt: Animated migration flow map between 12 US cities. Curved arrows with animated dashes show direction. Stroke width proportional to volume. City nodes sized by net migration (growing blue, shrinking red). Hover isolates a city's flows.

blocks.name: Projection Morphing Showcase
blocks.prompt: World map transitioning between 5 projections (NaturalEarth, Mercator, Orthographic, EqualEarth, Azimuthal). Auto-advances every 4s with 2s path interpolation. Buttons to jump. Countries colored by continent.

blocks.name: Horizon Chart Stack
blocks.prompt: Horizon chart: 8 server CPU series (1440 points each, 24 hours) with 3-layer fold technique. Include correlated spike clusters across server groups. Synchronized vertical crosshair shows all server values at that minute.

blocks.name: Swimlane Gantt Chart
blocks.prompt: Gantt chart with 35 tasks across 5 team swimlanes. Status-colored bars (complete/in-progress/blocked). Dependency arrows, milestone diamonds, today line. Brush-to-zoom via overview bar.

blocks.name: Cycle Plot
blocks.prompt: Cycle plot of 5 years monthly retail sales. 12 side-by-side panels (one per month), each showing year-over-year trend. Monthly mean lines. Holiday season bracket annotation. Labels for highs and lows.

blocks.name: Bar Chart Race
blocks.prompt: Bar chart race of GDP for 15 countries over 30 years. Realistic growth patterns (China rising, Japan stagnant). Top 12 shown, bars reorder as rankings change. Play/pause and speed controls.

blocks.name: Scrollytelling Climate
blocks.prompt: Scroll-driven temperature anomaly narrative (140 years). Sticky chart transitions through 5 stages: baseline explanation, stable century, acceleration (blue→red), record-breaking years, trend line with per-decade slope.

blocks.name: Streaming Real-Time Line
blocks.prompt: Real-time streaming line chart. Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process emits values every 100ms. Canvas renders 60-second rolling window. Overview shows last 5 minutes with LTTB downsampling. Brush overview to scroll. Pause and speed controls.

blocks.name: Shape Morphing Gallery
blocks.prompt: 3x3 grid of shape-morphing demos on continuous loops: circle-rect, bar-pie, star-circle, line-area, scatter-bar, horizontal-vertical bars, grouped-stacked, treemap-circle-pack, donut-sunburst. Each interpolates between two chart representations. Stagger timing so cells don't sync.

blocks.name: Annotation Showcase
blocks.prompt: Richly annotated line chart of 2 years synthetic stock prices (random walk with crash and recovery). Demonstrate callout labels with leader lines, threshold bands, event markers, trend line, range arrow, and force-based label collision avoidance.

blocks.name: Visual Texture Accessibility Chart
blocks.prompt: Grouped bar chart with dual encoding: color + SVG pattern fills (hatching, stripes, stipple, crosshatch). Side-by-side normal vision and deuteranopia simulation. Patterns remain distinguishable without color.

blocks.name: Color Palette Explorer
blocks.prompt: Interactive palette comparison tool. Bar chart switches between 6 palettes (Tol Bright/Vibrant/Muted/Light, Tableau10, Category10). WCAG contrast matrix for current palette. CVD simulation strips (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia).

blocks.name: Responsive Multi-Breakpoint
blocks.prompt: Chart that restructures at 3 breakpoints. Wide (≥1000px): scatter with marginal histograms. Medium: simplified scatter, legend below. Narrow (<600px): strip plot with box overlays. Elements animate between layouts via ResizeObserver.

blocks.name: Accessible Canvas Scatterplot
blocks.prompt: Accessible 1500-point Canvas scatterplot. Keyboard navigation (arrow keys between points sorted by x). Focus ring overlay, ARIA live region announces each point. Data table toggle shows all rows with sortable columns.

blocks.name: Dual-Axis with Gap Handling
blocks.prompt: Dual-axis time series (temperature line + rainfall bars) with gap handling. Dashed lines bridge sensor-offline gaps, hatched bars mark missing data. Reference bands for normal ranges. Broken axis indicator.

blocks.name: Quadtree Hit Detection Demo
blocks.prompt: Quadtree nearest-neighbor demo with 5000 Canvas particles in 8 categories. Mousemove finds 10 nearest via quadtree, highlights with glow and connector lines. Voronoi overlay toggle. Scroll zoom with quadtree recompute.

blocks.name: Minimap Navigator
blocks.prompt: Dense Canvas line chart (50,000 points, fractal random walk) with minimap overview. LTTB downsamples to 500 for overview. Brush minimap to navigate. Scroll zoom on main chart. LOD shows dots at high zoom.

blocks.name: Force + Bundling + Chord Triptych
blocks.prompt: Three panels showing the same 40-node network: force layout, radial edge bundling, chord diagram. Linked hover across all three via d3.dispatch. Highlights corresponding node/group/edges in each view.

blocks.name: Phyllotaxis Data Art
blocks.prompt: Generative phyllotaxis animation. 2000 dots in golden-angle spiral on dark Canvas. Angle parameter oscillates creating shifting spiral arms. Additive-blend glow effect. Sliders for dot count, angle offset, speed.

blocks.name: Classification Choropleth Comparison
blocks.prompt: Four US choropleths of the same income data, each using a different classification: quantile, equal interval, natural breaks (Jenks), manual threshold. Slider adjusts class count. Hover highlights same state across all four maps. Shared histogram shows breakpoints.

blocks.name: Diverging Midpoint Heatmap
blocks.prompt: Calendar heatmap of daily temperature departures (3 cities × 12 months). Diverging scale: blue (cold) through white (zero) to red (hot). Annotated cold snaps, heat waves, and Singapore's narrow annual range.

blocks.name: Log Scale Bee Swarm
blocks.prompt: Bee swarm of 500 company revenues (log-normal, $100K–$1B) colored by 6 sectors. Scale toggle: Linear / Log / Symlog — shows how scale choice reshapes perception. Force re-simulates on toggle. Marginal box plot.

blocks.name: Threshold Scale KPI Dashboard
blocks.prompt: Server KPI table with 20 rows. CPU sparklines, memory bullet charts, status dots, uptime percentages. Threshold sliders (warning/critical) recolor all indicators live. Sortable with animated row repositioning.

blocks.name: Mixed-Scale Parallel Coordinates
blocks.prompt: Parallel coordinates with mixed scale types: 2 linear, 1 log (salary), 2 ordinal point, 1 linear. 300 employees colored by department. Canvas+SVG hybrid. Intersection brush filtering on each axis.

blocks.name: Scale Perception Network
blocks.prompt: 60-node social network with scale toggle for node size: Linear / Sqrt / Log. Shows how linear exaggerates high-influence nodes. Diverging color for sentiment. Dropdown transitions radii and reheats forceCollide.

blocks.name: Textured Network Diagram
blocks.prompt: Force-directed network (50 nodes, 6 communities) with SVG pattern fills following texton theory (hatching, dots, crosshatch, stripes, waves). Grayscale toggle proves communities remain distinguishable through texture alone.

blocks.name: Stippled Density Map
blocks.prompt: US population density as stipple dots on Canvas (1 dot = 10,000 people, ~30K total). Rejection-sampled inside state polygons. Print-friendly alternative to choropleth. Canonical TopoJSON atlas geometry.

blocks.name: Accessible Force Network
blocks.prompt: 150-node Canvas force graph with full keyboard navigation. d3.quadtree directional-cone arrow keys. ARIA live region announces node, community, and connections. Synced sortable data table below. Forced-colors media query support.

blocks.name: Accessible Choropleth
blocks.prompt: US Canvas choropleth with keyboard navigation (geographic sort order). Focus ring SVG overlay, ARIA live region announces state and value. Table toggle with sortable columns. Forced-colors replaces fills with Canvas patterns.

blocks.name: Textured Raincloud Plot
blocks.prompt: Raincloud plots (6 groups): half-violin KDE + box plot + jittered strip. Each group gets both a Tol color and an SVG pattern. Deuteranopia simulation toggle proves patterns carry the encoding without color.

blocks.name: Textured Bivariate Treemap
blocks.prompt: Bivariate treemap: color = category (6), pattern = subcategory, pattern spacing = growth rate (dense = negative, sparse = positive). Three variables encoded in two visual channels.

blocks.name: WebGL Million-Point Scatter
blocks.prompt: 1M-point WebGL scatterplot with instanced SDF circles. SVG brush updates per-instance visibility. Inset 2D histogram of brushed subset. Canvas 2D fallback toggle with FPS comparison.

blocks.name: WebGL Force Galaxy
blocks.prompt: 50K-node force simulation rendered with WebGL instanced circles. 8 communities, ~80K edges. Upload positions via bufferSubData each tick. Quadtree hover on SVG overlay. Reheat button.

blocks.name: WebGL Streaming Particles
blocks.prompt: 200K-particle flow visualization on WebGL. Particles follow a vector field, colored by velocity magnitude. Trail effect via semi-transparent quad overlay. Controls for particle count, flow speed, play/pause.

blocks.name: WebGL Density Heatmap
blocks.prompt: 5M-point density heatmap with semantic zoom. Low zoom: WebGL Gaussian splat with color ramp. High zoom (k≥4): individual points by cluster. LOD hysteresis between modes. d3.zoom with scaleExtent [1,200].

blocks.name: WebGL Edge-Bundled Network
blocks.prompt: Radial edge-bundled network: ~300 leaves, ~1200 dependency edges. WebGL tessellated Bezier curves with alpha taper. Tension slider recomputes control points. Hover highlights a node's edges.

blocks.name: WebGL Animated Treemap
blocks.prompt: 5000-leaf treemap animating between two value columns (revenue vs headcount) at 60fps with WebGL instanced quads. 800ms cubicInOut lerp of all positions. Toggle button switches layouts.

blocks.name: Progressive Crossfilter
blocks.prompt: 4-panel crossfilter for 100K records (scatter, histogram, bar, timeline). Progressive filtering: immediately show 10K-sample approximation, refine to full count on idle. Falcon-inspired precomputed histogram snapshots for O(1) updates.

blocks.name: Icicle Brush Explorer
blocks.prompt: Icicle chart of a file system (~500 leaves) linked to a log-scale file-size histogram. Brush the histogram to highlight matching files in the icicle. Click to zoom into subtrees. Breadcrumb navigation.

blocks.name: Semantic Zoom Distributions
blocks.prompt: 2000 points that change chart type on zoom: density contours (overview) → hexbins (medium) → individual labeled points (high zoom). LOD hysteresis prevents flickering between modes.

blocks.name: Strum Brush Parallel Coords
blocks.prompt: Parallel coordinates with strum (angular) brushing. 2000 rows × 8 columns. Alt+drag between adjacent axes creates angular selection line. Linked scatterplot below shows subset on the strummed axes. Multiple strums intersect.

blocks.name: Brush Composition Scatterplots
blocks.prompt: 3×2 scatterplot grid (300 points, 7 health metrics). Union/Intersection brush toggle composes selections across panels. Progressive annotations: count badge, then centroid crosshair, then outlier flags.

blocks.name: Falcon Prefetch Histogram
blocks.prompt: Time-series with brush driving detail histogram using Falcon prefetch. 500K events. Precompute 256 cumulative histograms for O(1) updates. Latency counter compares prefetch (<0.5ms) vs naive (10-50ms).

blocks.name: Temporal Edge Bundling
blocks.prompt: Radial edge-bundled network where edges have active time windows. Time slider (12 months) shows/hides edges. Play button auto-advances. Node size reflects current-month connection count.

blocks.name: Animated Sparkline Table
blocks.prompt: Server metrics table with animated sparklines. KPI cards at top with spark-bar, spark-area, win/loss, bullet chart. Load animation: clipPath reveals sparklines per row with stagger. Replay button.

blocks.name: Prediction Band Time Series
blocks.prompt: Revenue time series with prediction fan chart. 30 months actual, 6 months forecast with 50/80/95% confidence bands. Event marker annotations. Step-sequenced reveal button chains fade-ins to tell the story.

blocks.name: Gantt with Edge-Bundled Dependencies
blocks.prompt: Gantt chart with edge-bundled dependency curves. ~50 tasks across 4 phases. Dependencies routed via LCA path bundling. Hover highlights a task and all its dependency chains.

blocks.name: Small Multiples Force Network
blocks.prompt: 2×3 grid showing a network evolving over 6 months. Each panel is an independent force simulation. New edges green, removed edges red dashed. Animate button morphs between panels sequentially.

blocks.name: Scrollytelling Network Growth
blocks.prompt: Scrollytelling social network growth in 5 stages: founders → early adopters → communities → bridges → full network. Sticky force graph on right, narrative text scrolls on left. IntersectionObserver triggers transitions.

blocks.name: Expandable Hierarchy Data Table
blocks.prompt: Expandable tree-table of a file system (~200 items). Indented rows with expand/collapse toggles. Columns: name, size, proportion spark-bar, share donut, file count, modified date. Search auto-expands to matches. Sortable within each level.

blocks.name: Marimekko Chart
blocks.prompt: Marimekko (mosaic) chart of market share. 5 categories × 4 subcategories. Width proportional to category total, height proportional to subcategory share. d3.treemap with sliceDice tiling. Hover shows values and percentages.

blocks.name: Flame Chart Profiler
blocks.prompt: CPU flame chart (~800 stack frames, 8 modules). d3.partition flipped vertically. Canvas rendering with LOD labels at zoom levels. Click-to-zoom fits subtree. Horizontal d3.zoom with rAF throttle.

blocks.name: Treemap Sparkline Dashboard
blocks.prompt: Treemap with embedded sparklines in leaf cells. ~100 product lines across 5 divisions. Cells >60×40px show 12-month trend sparkline. KPI strip at top. ResizeObserver for responsive sparkline thresholds.

blocks.name: Sunburst Breadcrumb Brush
blocks.prompt: Sunburst with breadcrumb trail and radial brush on outer ring. 4-level product taxonomy (~150 leaves). Drag along outer arc to select angular range. Deselected arcs desaturate. Click inner rings to zoom.

blocks.name: Expandable Edge Bundle
blocks.prompt: Radial dendrogram with edge bundling and collapsible subtrees. Click internal node to collapse — edges aggregate into thicker bundled connections. Re-runs d3.cluster and animates positions with polar interpolation.

blocks.name: Reduced Motion Dashboard
blocks.prompt: 3-panel crossfilter dashboard respecting prefers-reduced-motion. Motion: 300ms transitions. Reduced: instant updates. Detects media query with manual override toggle for demo purposes.

blocks.name: Container Query Chart
blocks.prompt: Reusable chart component shown at 6 sizes via container queries. 600px+: full scatter with annotations. 300px: simplified. 150px: sparkline dots. <150px: single KPI number. Same data, all on one page.

blocks.name: Letter-Value Plot with Table Toggle
blocks.prompt: Letter-value plot (5 groups × 1000 values) with table toggle and forced-colors support. Nested rectangles at median/fourths/eighths/sixteenths. Forced-colors replaces fills with hatching at increasing density.

blocks.name: Accessible Hive Plot
blocks.prompt: Accessible hive plot: 3 axes (source/connector/sink), 80 nodes, ~120 edges. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate along and between axes. Focus ring, ARIA live announcements. Quadratic Bezier edges.

blocks.name: Community Detection with Table
blocks.prompt: Force network (100 nodes, 5 communities) with synced grouped data table. Click table row → highlight graph node. Click community header → highlight hull. Betweenness centrality, degree, d3.polygonHull.

blocks.name: Sparklines Embedded in Text
blocks.prompt: Word-sized sparklines embedded inline in narrative prose. 8 metrics (revenue, margins, churn, NPS, etc.) with 24-month trends. 60×12px inline SVGs flow with text. Data table below with sortable columns and trend sparklines.

blocks.name: Skill Constellation
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: force-directed network of skill co-occurrence in blocks.

blocks.name: Block × Skill Matrix
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: adjacency matrix of blocks vs skills.

blocks.name: Skill Anatomy Treemap
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: treemap of skill line counts grouped by category.

blocks.name: Agent Disagreement Parcoords
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: parallel coordinates of adversarial agent scores per block.

blocks.name: Score Ridge Plot
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: ridgeline plot of score distributions before and after calibration.

blocks.name: Skill Growth Sparklines
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: sortable table with sparkline growth curves per skill.

blocks.name: Test Coverage Heatmap
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: heatmap of test coverage across skills and test dimensions.

blocks.name: Score Delta Waterfall
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: waterfall chart of composite score changes from calibration.

blocks.name: Prompt Complexity Scatter
blocks.prompt: Self-visualization: scatter plot of prompt word count vs composite score.

blocks.name: Election Swing Map
blocks.prompt: Synthetic US county choropleth. Scrub a timeline slider (5 election cycles) to see counties shift red↔blue. Linked histogram shows the distribution of swing magnitude. Counties animate color smoothly between cycles. Brush the histogram to highlight counties on the map.

blocks.name: Flight Route Bundling
blocks.prompt: 50 airports as nodes on a projected US map, ~200 flight routes. Hierarchical edge bundling groups routes by region. Tension slider from 0 (straight lines) to 1 (fully bundled) reveals corridor structure. Canvas rendering. Hover an airport to isolate its routes.

blocks.name: Regional Parcoords Grid
blocks.prompt: Synthetic car dataset (200 cars, 6 numeric axes, 4 manufacturer regions). One parcoords panel per region in a 2×2 grid. Brush any axis in any panel — selection propagates across all four panels. Reveals how regional manufacturing priorities differ.

blocks.name: Supply Chain Sankey
blocks.prompt: Four-level Sankey: raw materials → components → products → markets (8→12→8→5 nodes). Animated flow particles along links. Hover a product to trace its full supply chain backward with highlighted paths. Brush a market to see which materials feed it.

blocks.name: Shape-Morphing Timeline
blocks.prompt: A single chart that morphs between 4 chart types (bar → line → area → scatter) as you scrub a timeline of the same dataset. Smooth point-resampled transitions. The shape encodes the same data but reveals different patterns in each form. Auto-play with pause.

blocks.name: Tidal Harmonic Decomposition
blocks.prompt: Synthetic tidal signal composed of 4 harmonic constituents (M2, S2, K1, O1). Toggle each component on/off to see how they compose. Cycle plot shows daily tidal pattern. Annotated peaks explain spring/neap tides. Linked ridgeline shows amplitude distributions.

blocks.name: City Similarity Explorer
blocks.prompt: 40 world cities on 6 axes (population, density, elevation, avg temp, rainfall, cost index). Brush axes to filter. Selected cities highlight on a small world map below. Tooltip shows city name. Reveals which distant cities are statistically similar.

blocks.name: WebGL Color Space
blocks.prompt: 1500 named CSS/Tol/ColorBrewer colors plotted in 3D OKLCH space. GPU-rendered points. Orbit controls to rotate. Slice planes to isolate lightness or chroma ranges. Hover shows color name, hex, and a swatch. Reveals perceptual clustering and gamut holes.

blocks.name: Earthquake Depth Globe
blocks.prompt: Rotating globe with 500 synthetic earthquakes. Point size = magnitude, color = depth (shallow yellow → deep purple). Linked depth-vs-magnitude scatter below. Ridgeline plot of depth distributions grouped by tectonic zone. Brush the scatter to highlight quakes on the globe.

blocks.name: Book Sentence Rhythm
blocks.prompt: Synthetic novel (20 chapters). Each chapter row shows: chapter number, word count, a sparkline of sentence lengths, and a mini violin of sentence length distribution. Sort by avg sentence length to find terse vs flowing chapters. Hover a sparkline to see the longest sentence.

blocks.name: Nutrient Treemap Explorer
blocks.prompt: Zoomable treemap of food groups → foods. Click to zoom into a group. Linked parcoords below shows nutritional axes (calories, protein, fat, carbs, fiber, sugar) for visible foods. Brush an axis in parcoords to highlight foods in the treemap.

blocks.name: Migration Flow Chord
blocks.prompt: Chord diagram of synthetic migration flows between 8 world regions. Time slider (5 decades). Chords animate width changes as you scrub time. Hover a region arc to see in/out balance. Stacked area chart below shows net migration over time for the hovered region.
